title: Extensible membranes in inviscid flow: aerodynamics and singular limits
summary: We develop a two-dimensional inviscid model for extensible membranes with continuous vortex shedding from both edges, coupled to a weak spectral Galerkin discretization of the membrane equation that permits direct computation at zero bending rigidity. Viewing the pressure jump as a flux for bound vorticity explains how membranes respond to concentrated fluid loading.
